preconditions.expression: isinstance(stdin, str) and 0 < len(stdin) <= 100 and all(c.isalpha() or c == '_' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: stdin is a non-empty string of length at most 100, containing only lowercase/uppercase letters and underscores.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(stdin.count(friend) == 1 for friend in ['Danil', 'Olya', 'Slava', 'Ann', 'Nikita']) else stdout == 'NO'
postconditions.description: stdout is 'YES' if and only if exactly one of the friends' names ('Danil', 'Olya', 'Slava', 'Ann', 'Nikita') appears exactly once in stdin (case-sensitive, substring match). Otherwise, stdout is 'NO'.
